page.layout: One column of running text with worked examples, set in centred and indented calculation layouts. Running head top centre-left, page number top right. Signature at the lower right of the text block. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Hic non multiplico neque addo: sed 68
temporis, quo vicina quædam turris pro-

page.notes: The calculation fragments at the top and in the division layouts use printed symbols that I cannot resolve with certainty; they are transcribed as close as the scan allows. "1 2" after "erectus," may be a footnote mark or a spaced "12"; kept as printed. The long-s in "sed" and "Quęstio" is read as plain s. The final sentence ends the page mid-calculation, which continues on the next page.
